fields.label: Findings
items: Contains acquisition control, preprocessing, offset/drift correction and coincidence counting only. There is NO SDP / security-analysis / Chernoff code, so Fig.4 and SI Table 2 can't be reproduced from released code.
drift_alt.py imports find_start_alt, which isn't in the archive. README says to install from requirements.txt, which isn't in the archive either.
Timetagger control scripts (AIT TTM8000) were deliberately left out (copyrighted vendor scripts).
Analysis expects TTM8000 text format (the tagfile_example files in DS-SCH23-TIMETAGS-V2).

fields.label: Reuse policy
fields.text: Don't copy code into QMint. Use it only as a read-only reference. Lane E should reimplement independently and cite the DOI. See LICENSE_AND_PATENT_RISKS.md R1.
